title: The Task Nobody Chose
title_ja: 誰も選ばなかった仕事
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空の教育事例。実在の調査・教育効果の実証ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Five students are planning a class event.
sentences.ja: 五人の生徒はクラス行事を計画している。

sentences.en: They divide the work according to their interests.
sentences.ja: 関心に応じて仕事を分ける。

sentences.en: Two students want to design posters, and others want to organize games.
sentences.ja: 二人はポスターを作りたいと思い、他の生徒はゲームを企画したいと思う。

sentences.en: However, nobody volunteers to check the equipment after the event.
sentences.ja: しかし行事後の機材確認に立候補する人はいない。

sentences.en: One student suggests assigning the unpopular task to the person with the fewest other responsibilities.
sentences.ja: 一人は他の責任が最も少ない人に人気のない仕事を割り当てるよう提案する。

sentences.en: Another student points out that the group has not discussed how much time each task actually requires.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は各仕事に実際どれだけ時間がかかるか話し合っていないと指摘する。

sentences.en: Designing a poster might involve several hours of preparation, while checking equipment might involve a shorter period of work.
sentences.ja: ポスターのデザインには数時間の準備が必要かもしれず、機材確認はより短時間の仕事かもしれない。

sentences.en: The students realize that counting tasks does not necessarily reveal how fairly the work is distributed.
sentences.ja: 仕事数を数えても仕事がどれほど公平に分配されているか必ずしも分からないと気づく。

sentences.en: They prepare a list describing the expected time, necessary skills and deadlines for each responsibility.
sentences.ja: 各責任の予想時間、必要な技能、期限を記述した一覧を用意する。

sentences.en: Some estimates are uncertain, so they decide to review the arrangement during their preparation.
sentences.ja: 一部の見積もりは不確実なので準備中に分担を見直すことにする。

sentences.en: Two students agree to share the equipment task instead of leaving it to one person.
sentences.ja: 二人は一人に任せず機材確認を分担することに同意する。

sentences.en: The group also agrees to exchange responsibilities if someone encounters an unexpected difficulty.
sentences.ja: 誰かが予期しない困難に出会えば責任を交換することにも同意する。

sentences.en: After the event, the students discuss which parts of the arrangement were helpful.
sentences.ja: 行事後にどの分担が有用だったか議論する。

sentences.en: They discover that several small tasks required more attention than they had originally expected.
sentences.ja: 小さな仕事のいくつかは当初予想より多くの注意が必要だったと知る。

sentences.en: The conversation helps them prepare more realistic plans for future activities.
sentences.ja: 会話は将来の活動により現実的な計画を用意する助けになる。

sentences.en: It also gives them a chance to recognize contributions that were not immediately visible to others.
sentences.ja: 他者にはすぐ見えなかった貢献を認める機会にもなる。

sentences.en: Cooperation does not always mean that everyone performs an identical number of tasks.
sentences.ja: 協力は常に全員が同数の仕事をすることを意味しない。

sentences.en: A group must consider how much effort different responsibilities involve.
sentences.ja: 集団は異なる責任がどれほど労力を伴うか考えなければならない。

sentences.en: It can also make its plans easier to adjust when actual conditions differ from initial expectations.
sentences.ja: 実際の条件が当初の期待と異なるとき調整しやすい計画にもできる。

sentences.en: The task nobody chose becomes an opportunity to learn about fairness.
sentences.ja: 誰も選ばなかった仕事は公平さを学ぶ機会になる。

vocabulary.definition: things one is expected to do
in a way that must occur
state of being hard to do

questions.prompt: What does nobody volunteer to do?

options: There are no students in the group.
The event has already been canceled.
Students choose tasks according to their interests.

questions.prompt: What information have they not discussed?
options: The date of the school year.

questions.prompt: Why might counting tasks be misleading?
options: Each task has exactly the same difficulty.
Every student must perform all tasks.
Different tasks may require different amounts of effort.

questions.prompt: What do they include in the list?
options: Only the names of unpopular tasks.

questions.prompt: Why plan to review the arrangement?
options: They already know every future difficulty.
No one wants to prepare anything.
Actual conditions may differ from their estimates.

questions.prompt: What do they discover after the event?
options: Some small tasks required more attention than expected.
questions.explanation_ja: 小さな仕事の予想外の労力。

options: It helps recognize contributions and improve future plans.
It proves that everyone contributed identically.
It eliminates the need for future cooperation.
It makes every task equally popular.
questions.explanation_ja: 今後の計画と貢献認識。

options: Every person must perform exactly the same number of tasks.
Fair cooperation requires considering actual effort and adjusting responsibilities.
Unpopular work should always be ignored.
questions.explanation_ja: 労力と調整を考慮した分担。

grammar.focus: instead of leaving it to one person
when actual conditions differ from initial expectations
grammar.explanation_ja: when節は時間・条件、differ fromは異なる。

paraphrases.source: They divide the work according to their interests.
paraphrases.rewrite: They assign tasks based on what members are interested in.

paraphrases.source: Designing a poster might involve several hours of preparation, while checking equipment might involve a shorter period of work.
paraphrases.rewrite: Poster design and equipment checks may require different amounts of time.

paraphrases.source: Two students agree to share the equipment task instead of leaving it to one person.
paraphrases.rewrite: Two people agree to perform the equipment task together.

paraphrases.source: It can also make its plans easier to adjust when actual conditions differ from initial expectations.
paraphrases.rewrite: Plans can be flexible when reality does not match early estimates.

discourse.role_ja: 希望する仕事と誰も選ばない仕事。
不確実な見積もりから見直しへ。
